externalBlockers.monitorSignal: GitHub Billing and Actions UI show account and workflow can run
externalBlockers.resumeCondition: Account lock warning absent and protected workflow runner can queue or start for the selected current main SHA
externalBlockers.stopCondition: Billing annotation, startup failure before logs, stale SHA, skipped required jobs, or repeated dispatch without confirmed unlock

externalBlockers.resumeCondition: Reviewer identity, date, reviewed packet hash, reviewed URLs, receipt hashes, blocker acknowledgement, and no-release-approval attestation are recorded
externalBlockers.stopCondition: Fake signoff or signoff interpreted as release, staging, hosting, managed infrastructure, or protected CI approval

externalBlockers.resumeCondition: Host, exact origin policy, operator, rollback owner, observability route, and stop conditions approved
externalBlockers.stopCondition: Public URL is invented or public hosting starts before approval

externalBlockers.resumeCondition: Durable DB, credential manager, backup target, queue design, restore owner, and connection plan approved
externalBlockers.stopCondition: Managed DB, cloud credential manager, queue, or backup target is connected before approval

mixedRepoWorkflowBlockers.resumeCondition: All ten required checks pass on the selected current main SHA
mixedRepoWorkflowBlockers.stopCondition: Any missing, skipped, renamed, failing, or non-current required check

mixedRepoWorkflowBlockers.resumeCondition: Protected workflow emits staging-named artifact manifest, provenance report, sidecar, and upload metadata
mixedRepoWorkflowBlockers.stopCondition: Zero artifacts or local-advisory files promoted as protected evidence

mixedRepoWorkflowBlockers.resumeCondition: Required checks are configured and passing on the protected branch
mixedRepoWorkflowBlockers.stopCondition: Bypass, missing contexts, or mismatch between configured and canonical check names

mixedRepoWorkflowBlockers.resumeCondition: Protected CI, protected artifacts, branch protection, rollback owner, partner/customer decision, hosting approval, and managed infrastructure approval are complete
mixedRepoWorkflowBlockers.stopCondition: Any local-advisory result is used as release authority

finalDecision.nextAction: Wait for external blocker state change before creating any further execution sprint.
